milestone: Sign Thalweg's first paying customer. Thalweg turns raw sonar data into fish counts legally required to produce them - dam operators in FERC relicensing, state, federal, tribal and local fisheries and environmental monitoring programs, as well as the consultants they hire. The milestone is a signed deployment agreement with one of these buyers at a per-deployment price, deposited at signing.
metrics: 1 paying customer, 25 obligated buyers, 10 discovery calls, 3 proposals sent
